request.title: Whitelist request
confirm.undo_approval: ⚠️ Undo approval for player {0} (request {1})? This removes the player from the vanilla whitelist and reopens the request.
confirm.reopen: ⚠️ Reopen the denied request for player {0} (request {1})?
confirm.expired: This request or action is no longer available. Refresh the request state and try again.
command.help:
Gatehouse commands:
/gatehouse list [pending|resolving|approved|denied|blocked]
/gatehouse show <request-id|username>
/gatehouse approve|deny|block|undo <request-id|username> [reason...]
/gatehouse unblock <username> [reason...]
/gatehouse status
/gatehouse reload
command.list_truncated: Showing the 50 most recently updated requests. Narrow the list with /gatehouse list <status>.
command.request_not_found_key: No request found for {0}. Use /gatehouse list to see recent requests.
command.no_active_request: No active request found for {0}. Use /gatehouse show {0} to inspect its latest request.
command.no_terminal_request: No approved, denied, or blocked request found for {0} to undo.
command.invalid_status: Unknown request status '{0}'. Use pending, resolving, approved, denied, or blocked.
command.starting: Gatehouse is still starting. Try again shortly or run /gatehouse status.
command.not_available: Gatehouse request operations are unavailable because the runtime is degraded. Run /gatehouse status and check the server log.
command.health_starting: Gatehouse health: STARTING — runtime initialization is still in progress.
command.health_healthy: Gatehouse health: HEALTHY — queue={0}, pending deliveries={1}, providers: {2}
command.health_degraded: Gatehouse health: DEGRADED — queue={0}, pending deliveries unavailable ({1}), providers: {2}
command.health_core_degraded: Gatehouse health: DEGRADED — request storage/workers are unavailable. Providers: {0}. Check the server log for the startup failure.
command.reload_failed: Gatehouse reload failed; the previous runtime was kept unchanged: {0}
command.reload_restart_required: Reload rejected because database.path changed. Restart the server to apply a database path change.
